component.name: Maskrom Studio
component.summary: Install and restore systems and UEFI firmware on Rockchip boards

description.p: Maskrom Studio installs Windows 11 23H2 on the eMMC of Rockchip RK3576 boards (LCKFB TaishanPi 3M, ArmSoM CM5-IO) from a computer over USB, without a USB stick: it writes the woa-rk3576 WinPE and your Windows image to the eMMC in Maskrom mode, and the board installs Windows from there by itself.
It also writes and upgrades the edk2-rk3576 UEFI firmware (keeping Windows and the saved settings), and puts the board back to Armbian or to a factory image you downloaded.
First version, forked from Roxora Imager 0.1.10: Windows on the eMMC without a USB stick, firmware writes, and writing the board it runs on.
